## The Code

### Install packages


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(sf, ggstatsplot, tmap, tidyverse, knitr, GWmodel)
```
:::


## Preparing the Data

### Importing Hunan shapefile


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_sf <- st_read(dsn = "data/geospatial", layer = "Hunan")
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}


### importing Hunan_2012 table


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan2012 <- read_csv("data/aspatial/Hunan_2012.csv")
```
:::


### Joining Hunan and Hunan_2012


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_sf <- left_join(hunan_sf, hunan2012) %>%
  select(1:3, 7, 15, 16, 31, 32)
```
:::

## Converting to SpatialPolygonDataFrame


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_sp <- hunan_sf %>%
```


### Computing geographically weighted summary statistics

The code chunk below computes geographically weighted summary statistics by using gwss() of GWmodel package. The analysis is performed using adaptive distance weighted. The distance is derived using AICc method and the kernel method used is bisquare.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gw_stat <- gwss(data = hunan_sp,
                vars = "GDPPC",
                bw = bw_AIC,
                kernel = "bisquare",
                adaptive = TRUE,
                quantile = TRUE,
                longlat = T) 
```
:::


### Preparing the output data

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gwstat_df <- as.data.frame(gw_stat$SDF)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_gstat <- cbind(hunan_sf, gwstat_df)
```
:::

## Geospatial analytics solution
### Determine the bandwidth


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
bw <- bw.gwr(GDPPC ~ GIO, 
             data = hunan_sp, 
             approach = "AICc",
             kernel = "bisquare",
             adaptive = TRUE)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 62 AICc value: 1870.235 
Adaptive bandwidth (number of nearest neighbours): 46 AICc value: 1870.852

```


:::
:::

### Computing gwCorrelation

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gwstats <- gwss(hunan_sp, 
                vars = c("GDPPC", "GIO"), 
                bw = bw,
                kernel = "bisquare",
                adaptive = TRUE, 
                longlat = T)
```
:::


### Extracting the Result

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gwstat_df <- as.data.frame(gwstats$SDF) %>%
  select(c(12,13)) %>%
  rename(gwCorr = Corr_GDPPC.GIO,
         gwSpearman = Spearman_rho_GDPPC.GIO)
```
:::



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
hunan_Corr <- cbind(hunan_sf, gwstat_df)
```
:::


## Visualising Local Correlation


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tm_shape(hunan_Corr) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "gwSpearman",
              fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
                style = "quantile",
                n = 5,
                values = "brewer.blues"),
              fill.legend = tm_legend(
                title = "local Spearman Rho")) +
  tm_borders(fill_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_title("Local Spearman Rho", 
  size = 2.0) +
  tm_layout(frame = TRUE)
```
